tools.name: share_markdown
tools.description: Share a markdown file and get a public URL. Returns an edit token that can be used later to update or delete the share.

tools.name: update_share
tools.description: Replace the content of an existing share using its id and edit token.

tools.name: delete_share
tools.description: Permanently delete a share using its id and edit token.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: share_markdown · Private data: share_markdown, update_share, delete_share · Public sink: share_markdown, update_share, delete_share · Destructive: share_markdown, delete_share.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: share_markdown · Private data: share_markdown, update_share, delete_share · Public sink: share_markdown, update_share, delete_share · Destructive: share_markdown, delete_share

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
